assertions.subject: Vascular Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: silent infarcts, commonly found in the basal ganglia, can be a causative factor for vascular parkinsonism

assertions.subject: Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: the presence of infarcts in the basal ganglia, along with other clinical and physiological factors, contributes to the development of parkinsonism

assertions.subject: Drug-Induced Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: dopamine D2 receptors in the striatum are either structurally or functionally blocked by dopamine D2 receptor antagonists

assertions.subject: Drug-Induced Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: This blockade leads to decreased dopamine levels, resulting in dysfunction similar to what is observed in Parkinson disease

assertions.subject: Antipsychotic-Induced Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: dopamine D2 receptors in the striatum are either structurally or functionally blocked by dopamine D2 receptor antagonists
